messages:
deploybot: Production deploy started for service=infra-runtime env=prod
deploybot: tag=release-3.4.3 commit=f2a3b1 initiated_by=@mike :rocket:

mike: starting canary rollout -> 5% traffic. watching p99 latency and error-rate.

anita: looking at canary dashboards now, CPU and GPU memory look normal. will call if anything spikes.

cheng: pinned model-config to commit f2a3b1 in infra-configs (no schema changes).
cheng: verified DB migration flag is off for this rollout.

release-coordinator: quick check — change window approved until 22:30 PT, notify if we need an extension.

infra-sre: created a monitoring alert group "prod-infra-runtime-canary" and a rollback runbook link: https://runbooks.internal/rollback-infra-runtime

mike: rolling canary to 25% now. bumping connections and running a couple synthetic requests (inc. long context).

anita: synthetic passes for short+long prompts. no OOMs in canary. :thumbsup:

deploybot: Canary phase complete for tag=release-3.4.3 commit=f2a3b1. proceeding to traffic shift -> 100% in 6m.

mike: shifting to 100% traffic. will monitor error budget and tracing.

infra-sre: quick heads-up — two 5xx spikes right at the start of shift, investigating traces.

anita: I see a transient tail lat increase on a small subset routed to eu-west-1. rolling metrics back to baseline now.

cheng: checked model shards — KV cache warmed, no missing weights. looks like an autoscaler jitter in eu-west-1, not model-level.

mike: pausing traffic shift at 65% to confirm stabilization. please shout if anything looks off.

infra-sre: confirmed autoscaler flaps, increased cooldown window and manually scaled pods in eu-west-1.

mike: resuming shift to 100%.

deploybot: Production deploy completed for service=infra-runtime env=prod
deploybot: tag=release-3.4.3 commit=f2a3b1 duration=00:17:34 status=SUCCESS

release-coordinator: nice — post-rollout checklist: update release notes, tag pinned in console, notify customers if SLA change.

mike: release notes updated, tag pinned, and added alert annotations for today. thanks everyone. :party_parrot:

infra-sre: created a fallback/rollback ticket (ID #RR-4721) and left instructions in the runbook in case we need to revert.

anita: monitoring steady after 10m. closing canary watch.

cheng: will run a quick smoke job against internal test harness in 30m to validate edge cases.

deploybot: Automated post-deploy verification: 12/12 checks passed (latency,error-rate,kv-cache,telemetry,rollout-integrity).

mike: marking this as done in the release tracker. Thanks all for quick responses.
